verdicts.reasoning: All the sampled seeds require solving a division problem, such as dividing a total amount of money among friends (e.g., seed 11: ₱390 divided by 5) or distributing items into bags (e.g., seed 23: 240 sneakers into bags of 4).

The dividends presented in all the items are strictly 2- or 3-digit numbers. For instance, seeds 57 and 127 use the 2-digit dividends 50 and 60, while seeds 11 and 103 use the 3-digit dividends 390 and 400.
All division items uniformly use a 1-digit number as the divisor. The problems involve sharing or dividing by numbers such as 5 (seed 11), 4 (seed 23), 2 (seed 42), and 3 (seed 78).
Several items explicitly incorporate money into the division problem by using Philippine Pesos (₱). Seed 11 involves ₱390, seed 57 involves ₱50, and seed 91 involves ₱126.
